newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end higher on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end higher on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates ended down on Thursday amid a shortage of liquidity but are likely to remain stead on Friday because of a low demand for funds, dealers said.
Early overnight deals were struck at seven percent but shortage of funds pushed the rates up and the market closed at 12 percent, one dealer said.
Low demand for funds is likely to help the market maintain current levels on Friday, he said.
